sec.title: Master Undated Resolution Pipeline (Batch 1 of 1,607)
sec.p: This archival dispatch inaugurates **Stage 1** of our systematic backlog resolution covering all 80,308 undated audio broadcasts across the archive.

**Batch 1** resolves **50 previously undated broadcasts** from Edward R. Murrow's landmark CBS series *This I Believe* (1951–1955), which featured prominent global figures, humanitarians, educators, and everyday citizens sharing their personal credos and life philosophies.
